page.notes: Greek passages partly illegible on the scan: the phrase after "capite", the lemma "τὰ ἱμάτια …", the phrase after "οἱ λέσ-τες τὸν ἀέρα", and the Plutarch quotation after "ὡς καθάπερ" were not readable letter by letter and are marked. "Motte pleĉtebantur" is probably "Mulctebantur"; the scan is unclear and the word is copied as read. The Greek of "ὑπὲρ δέκα δραχμάς" and "νίκας λεῖοντες καὶ διαλύσιον" is a best reading and should be checked. No catchword is visible.
